title: AURUMSHIFT_EXTERNAL_RISK_CAPACITY_AND_TURNOVER_ALLOCATION_V1 - pre-registration
status: Written after TUNING and VALIDATION, before the HELDOUT run. HELDOUT results have not been generated or inspected.

heldout.families: S1..S12 + H1_chronic_corr_regime, H2_burst_noisy_missing, H3_spam_fastslow (H* never used in tuning/validation)

primary_metric: lat_per_slot_hour: latent expected net outcome per slot-hour (bps, costs explicit, UNKNOWN_COST != 0), normalised by dens0_sd (std of per-opportunity value density in that run) => dz; paired against a reference policy on identical worlds (common random numbers).
unit_of_analysis: pooled: mean over caps of dz per (family,variant,seed) block, bootstrap 95% CI over blocks (4000 resamples); cells: (family,cap) mean over variant x seed
shortlist_rule: Top-3 distinct method families by VALIDATION pooled dz vs FIFO (oracles, baselines and controls excluded). RANK_NET (simple net-EV ranking) is always evaluated as the simple reference in addition.
core_criteria: (a) pooled dz vs FIFO >= delta_material with CI lower > 0; (b) >= 60% of (family,cap) cells with CI lower > 0; (c) <= 15% of cells materially worse than FIFO (dz <= -delta_material and CI upper < 0)
beats_simple_criteria: (d) pooled dz vs RANK_NET >= delta_equivalence with CI lower > 0; (e) positive pooled dz vs RANK_NET at >= 3 of 4 caps; (f) leakage tests pass
verdict_rules: STUDY_INCONCLUSIVE if leakage tests fail OR max pooled CI half-width vs FIFO > delta_material.
Else if >=1 shortlist method meets core AND beats-simple: if >=2 are within delta_equivalence of the best => MULTIPLE_CAPACITY_METHODS_SUPPORTED; else CAPACITY_ALLOCATION_REFERENCE_SUPPORTED.

Else if RANK_NET meets core AND beats FIFO_NETPOS by >= delta_equivalence (CI lower > 0): if >=2 shortlist methods meet core and are within delta_equivalence of RANK_NET => MULTIPLE_CAPACITY_METHODS_SUPPORTED; else CAPACITY_ALLOCATION_REFERENCE_SUPPORTED (reference = RANK_NET).
Else FIFO_REMAINS_SUFFICIENT unless the gain over FIFO is real (RANK_NET meets core and CI of gain over FIFO_NETPOS exceeds delta_equivalence), in which case NO_CAPACITY_METHOD_SUPPORTED.

'FIFO' in the verdict labels means FIFO with a net-positive admissibility filter (FIFO_NETPOS) whenever pure FIFO's loss is attributable only to admitting negative-expected-value opportunities; both comparisons are always reported.
fifo_failure_rule: Per family, caps 4 and 6 pooled: best of {RANK_NET}+shortlist has dz vs FIFO >= delta_material with CI lower > 0 => FIFO_FAIL. FIFO_EQUIV if the CI upper bound of that best dz < 0.05. Also reported vs FIFO_NETPOS (filtering removed). Best-of selection inflates FIFO_FAIL; stated as a limitation.
reference_picks: BEST_SLOT_HOUR / BEST_DIVERSIFICATION / BEST_TURNOVER references are descriptive: highest heldout pooled dz (lat) within {SLOTHOUR_*,SHADOW_PRICE,FLUID_QUANTILE,ONLINE_KNAPSACK_PSI} / {CLUSTER_CAP,CORR_PENALTY,MARGINAL_RISK,CORR_HARD_REJECT} (also ranked by ret_to_risk) / {SLOTHOUR_*,EVICT_SWAP,OLDEST_SLOT,SHADOW_PRICE}, always shown next to RANK_NET and reported as 'not distinguishable' when the paired CI vs RANK_NET includes 0 or |diff| < delta_equivalence.
oracle_policy: ORACLE_* and the offline LP bound are upper-bound references only and never enter any verdict rule.
forbidden_after_this_file: Changing tuned params, grids, thresholds, shortlist, scenarios, seeds or verdict script after the held-out run. runner.py heldout aborts if tuned params changed.
